getApp.title: Install ServisGo on your device
getApp.subtitle: One app for Android, iPhone, iPad, Windows and Mac. Install it straight from this page — it then opens from your home screen or desktop like any other app, with no app store account.
getApp.installedNow: Installed — look for ServisGo with your other apps
getApp.runningInstalled: You are already using the installed app
getApp.followSteps: This browser has no one-tap install. Follow the steps for your device below — it takes about 20 seconds.
getApp.noStoreNeeded: Free · no Play Store or App Store account · installs in seconds
getApp.loginLink: Install the app on your phone or computer
getApp.iosSafariOnly: On iPhone and iPad only Safari can add the app to the home screen. Open this page in Safari first, then follow the steps.

android: Tap the ⋮ menu at the top right.
Confirm with Install — ServisGo appears with your other apps.
androidSamsung: Open this page in Samsung Internet.
Tap the ☰ menu at the bottom of the screen.
Tap Add — ServisGo appears with your other apps.
ios: Tap the Share button at the bottom of the screen.
Scroll down and choose “Add to Home Screen”.
Tap Add — ServisGo appears on your home screen.
windows: Open this page in Chrome or Edge.
Click the install icon at the end of the address bar (a screen with a down arrow).
Pin ServisGo to the taskbar or Start menu when Windows offers to.
macos: Open this page in Chrome or Edge.
Click the install icon at the end of the address bar, then Install.
On Safari 17 or newer choose File → Add to Dock instead.
ServisGo now opens in its own window from the Dock or Launchpad.

notes.android: Nothing changes about signing in — it is the same account you use in the browser.
notes.ios: The Share button is the square with an arrow pointing up.
notes.windows: No install icon? Open the ⋮ menu → Cast, save and share → Install this site as an app.
notes.macos: On Safari older than 17, install with Chrome or Edge instead.

visitStatus.meaning_pending: Booked but the technician has not started it. It is still an appointment on the calendar, nothing more.
visitStatus.meaning_inProgress: The technician has opened the job and is working through it.
visitStatus.meaning_awaitingApproval: The technician found extra work and asked the customer to approve it. Nothing more happens until the customer answers.
visitStatus.meaning_completed: The visit finished. Readings, parts and any follow-up have been recorded.
visitStatus.meaning_cancelled: The visit was called off and will not happen.
visitStatus.meaning_unknown: This status is not recognised by the system.
visitStatus.action_pending: Confirm it with the customer, assign a technician if it has none, and reschedule it if the date has passed.
visitStatus.action_inProgress: Nothing from the office — wait for the technician, or call them if it is taking too long.
visitStatus.action_awaitingApproval: Call the customer and get an answer, then record it so the technician can carry on.
visitStatus.action_completed: Raise the invoice if it has not been raised, and check the next visit is booked.
visitStatus.action_cancelled: Book a replacement visit if the customer still needs the work.
visitStatus.action_unknown: Open the record and set a correct status.
visitStatus.reason_waitingCustomerApproval: Approval request sent to the customer

requestStatus.meaning_pending: The system or a person asked for a visit and nobody has booked one yet. This is the queue of work waiting to be turned into appointments.
requestStatus.meaning_scheduled: A visit was booked from this request. The request stays for the record and closes itself.
requestStatus.meaning_dismissed: Someone decided no visit is needed. It stays visible so the decision is traceable.
requestStatus.meaning_unknown: This status is not recognised by the system.
requestStatus.action_pending: Call the customer, agree a date, and book the visit from here so the request closes itself.
requestStatus.action_scheduled: Nothing — follow the visit in the Appointments tab.
requestStatus.action_dismissed: Nothing. Raise a new request if the situation changes.
requestStatus.action_unknown: Open the record and set a correct status.
requestStatus.reason_part_due: A filter is due for replacement
requestStatus.reason_followup: The technician asked for a follow-up
requestStatus.reason_customer_request: The customer asked for a visit
